title: FormalCRRC reproducibility archive: exact rubric-threshold sweeps for LLM-judge evaluation
description:
Reproducibility archive for FormalCRRC: Locating and Repairing Rubric Decision Boundaries in LLM Judges. Contains source code, frozen datasets and prompts, preregistrations and amendments, raw judge scores, metrics, integrity records, and analysis code for the synthetic studies and the post-hoc analyses reported in the paper, including the level-0 and held-out per-level calibration analyses added in response to review. All reported analyses can be reproduced from the saved scores without model inference; see REPRODUCIBILITY.md.

Anonymous review release: creator names and the related publication are added at publication.
